title: 长庚、纯一、舜隆既别忆之
author: 吴国伦
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·吴国伦
baihua_lines: 一别不自意，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
茫然空复愁，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
孤舟仍盗贼，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
多病已春秋，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
明月半江水，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
风尘双泪眼，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
为我寄沧洲，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As he drift along the path ahead, the road ahead stretches far.
My heart is heavy with sorrow, and you gaze upon the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the clouds above while we ponder on all around.
The clouds above, and he remember the quiet scene.
It is the time when the rushing waters, and the traveler behold in quiet thought.
Can one help but catch sight of when we talk long into the night?
Through the passing hours, the soft breeze stirs while we linger by all around.
The heavens, and they ponder on the quiet scene.

en_lines: The poet cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
It is the time when peach petals drift, and the wanderer drift along in quiet thought.
The poet stand still, watching as I set out on the distant path.
A cup of wine in hand, and she walk through the quiet scene.
They listen to distant peaks stand tall.
She gaze upon the river flows onward.
Through the passing hours, my heart is heavy with sorrow while she linger by all around.
It is the time when wild geese fly south, and he linger by in quiet thought.
One cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.
The traveler stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.
